subject: Mutual action: probe asset transfer + timeboxed sandbox license

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: initial intro — evaluation assets and sandbox

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, we'd like to move forward with a short evaluation: RetailIQ would provision a small set of probe test cases (approx. 150 single-turn queries + 50 multi-turn scenarios) and a prompt pack for feature parity checks.

Key asks from our side:
- Short timeline: 2-week sandbox window after assets are exchanged
- Limited use: assets must be used only for model evaluation with no re-sharing outside RetailIQ/Redwood engineers
- Auditability: we need logs of inference calls for the window (anonymized ok)

Can you share a MAP-style plan and the access checklist so procurement can review? I've copied procurement procurement@retailiq.com for any contractual questions.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lim
Head of ML Platform
RetailIQ

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jan 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action: probe asset transfer + timeboxed sandbox license

Sara —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP and a short access checklist to get the sandbox stood up: RetailIQ_MAP_v1.pdf and access_checklist.csv. Summary of the proposal below (TL;DR).

Proposed timeline (example):
- Day 0: RetailIQ submits encrypted probe bundle (S3 link + checksum) to our intake bucket
- Day 1-2: Redwood runs intake scan & confirms compatibility; we provision sandbox environment (isolated VPC)
- Day 3-16: Evaluation window (14 days) — RetailIQ runs testcases against dedicated lightweight pool
- Day 17-21: Joint wrap-up call; agreed teardown and data destruction

Usage constraints (non-negotiable unless escalated):
- Non-distribution: RetailIQ may not redistribute probe assets beyond named contacts
- Retention: Redwood will retain raw probe assets for up to 30 days post-window for debugging; then automatic deletion unless a written exception is granted
- Telemetry: We will provide aggregated latency/cost metrics and per-request hashed IDs (no PII).

Deliverables included in the MAP: probe-testcases-list.csv (manifest), ephemeral license text (redwood-ephemeral-license.txt), and the access checklist. If procurement needs additional legal language we can route to contracts — Karthik is looped and can assist.

Attachments: RetailIQ_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), access_checklist.csv

Next steps: Please confirm the two named evaluators and procurement contact; if green, I will send a DocuSign with the ephemeral license and a Drive link to upload the assets.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Sara / Mina —

Following up from Mina's MAP draft. A couple procurement/contract bullets from our side so procurement@retailiq.com is aware before signature:
- Insurance and indemnity: standard SOW-level liability; we can provide a short addendum limited to the evaluation scope
- Access control: named evaluator accounts only; no service account exports
- Security evidence: we will provide the intake scan report and SOC-2 summary for the sandbox environment; note that debug logs provided will be hashed/anonymized by default

On the logistics side, please confirm:
1) Two named evaluators + email addresses
2) S3 upload contact (we prefer pre-signed URL sent to Mina)

I'll prepare a concise DocuSign for the ephemeral license once we have the evaluator list.
